chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinanī, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about two men who share a slave girl, so one of them emancipates his share. The slave girl says to the one who did not emancipate his share, 'I do not want you to evaluate me; leave me as I am, and I will serve you.' And he wanted to marry the other half. He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is not befitting for him to do so, because there are not two private parts for the woman, and it is not befitting that he makes her serve, but he should evaluate her so he can make her work for it (to be paid off).'

key_terms.يُسْتَسْعِيهَا: Make her work for it (to pay off her value)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling when one master frees his half of a shared slave girl?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of 'la yakunu lil-mar'ati farjan' (a woman has only one private part) to prevent polyandry in shared-slavery contexts, ensuring that partial emancipation does not lead to concurrent marital rights. The Imam mandates that the remaining master must either pay the valuation to fully emancipate her or retain her in a state of servitude without marriage, thereby preserving the exclusivity of the marital bond. This highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on practical equity and the physical reality of the body in determining legal capacity for marriage.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzaul, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about two men who happened to have the slave girl between them. So one of them emancipated his share of her, and the slave girl said to the one who did not emancipate his share, ‘I do not want that you evaluate me. Leave me just as I am your servant’, and he wanted to marry the other half’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Is it not befitting for him that he does so, because there do not happen to be two private parts for the woman, and it is not befitting that he makes her serve, but he should evaluate her, so he can make her work for it (to be paid off)’.
